description:
FILED s536c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) while building #1611's guard rows.  PRE-EXISTING on c950ad43 (main at s536) for an ordinary sub name; #1611 did not change it.

PPI lexes `-foo` as ONE Word.  `Pl/ExprToCL.pm`'s `_negated_call_form` (#476) turns a known `-NAME` Word into `(p-- (p-scalar-ctx (NAME)))` -- right for the bare spelling -- but `gen_funcall_form` then reads the head through `gen_node`, so with ARGUMENTS the negated zero-arg call becomes the FUNCTION NAME and the load dies "The function main::|pl-(p-- (p-scalar-ctx (pl-foo)))| is undefined":

    sub foo { "f(@_)" } print -foo(4), "\n";
      perl 5.40.3: -f(4)          PCL (base and tree): undefined-function, the whole run lost

The funcall branch for `-NAME LIST` (`if ($func_name =~ /^-([A-Za-z_]\w*)$/)`) is reached only for %RUNTIME_NAMES entries, because `_negated_call_form` declines exactly those -- so for them the bare spelling has the opposite bug:

    sub hash { 7 } print -hash, "\n";      perl: -7     PCL: -hash   (silent)
    sub hash { 7 } print -hash(4), "\n";   perl: -7     PCL: -7 since #1611 (s536c; was the runtime's hash constructor negated)

FIX SHAPE (not built): ONE reading of the `-NAME` Word -- gen_funcall_form takes the head token's CONTENT when it is `-NAME` (not gen_node's leaf rendering) and emits `(p-- (CALL NAME LIST))` for any NAME (perl: a word followed by `(` is a call), and `_negated_call_form` stops declining %RUNTIME_NAMES entries (asks `Pl::ExprToCL::source_call_is_builtin`, #1611's predicate; s536c tried exactly that half alone and it turned `-hash(4)` into this crash -- the two halves must land together).  Probe `-shift`, `-splice @a`, `-foo => 1` (autoquote stays), `-e $f` (an Operator, untouched).

=== DONE (s536g) ===
Fixed together with #4222 by ONE reading of the `-NAME` Word: `Pl::PExpr::_split_negated_call_words` splits it into `-` + `NAME` where NAME is callable (a keyword / builtin, a declared-above or imported sub, or a `(` follows), so `-foo(4)` is `(p-- (p-scalar-ctx (pl-foo 4)))`, `-hash` with a user `sub hash` is -7 (the call; was the string "-hash"), `-hash(4)` -7, `-shift(@a)` / `-shift @a` / a bare `-shift` in a sub negate the shift (a bare `-shift` was the string "-shift").  `_negated_call_form` and gen_funcall_form's runtime-name branch DELETED (both halves landed together, as the filing required).  `-foo => 1` keeps the string; `-e $f` (an Operator) untouched.  Guard Pl/t/minus-word-01.t rows 27-31 (inverse-verified on c8886b61).  Commit 0ff2973d.
subject: `-NAME(LIST)` with a known sub crashes the run (the head lowers to `|pl-(p-- (p-scalar-ctx (pl-NAME)))|`), and `-NAME` alone with a declared sub of a runtime-internal name is the STRING "-NAME"
